name: Sakuraba Hiroshi
source: Sakuraba is an airhead friend of [url=https://vndb.org/c3658]Taichi[/url] and [url=https://vndb.org/c3665]Tomoki[/url] that also attends Gunjo Academy and is a member of school's broadcasting club. Considering how wealthy his family is, he appears to be rather modest in his personality. His favourite food appears to be curry bread. He didn't have to enroll at Gunjo Academy because he scored 15% on his adaptation test exam. He chose Gunjo Academy because that was the school he wanted to go to and because a certain other person was attending it too.
